configured_security_gate.command: ruff check services packages scripts --select S --ignore S101
configured_security_gate.scope: selected runtime/tooling security rules; asserts excluded by the existing CI policy

extra_broad_diagnostic.command: ruff check --select S services packages scripts tests
extra_broad_diagnostic.interpretation: All 528 findings are S101 assertions in tests or verification/drill tooling. This broad diagnostic is not reported as a pass.
